champion.tips: GRAVES TIPS AND TRICKS When duelling an enemy champion, position your Q towards a wall so it explodes quickly. You can cancel auto-attack animations with your E . Never use your E if you have 2 auto attacks available as your E will reset 1 auto. Your E and Ultimate R can be used to chase or escape sticky situations. You can also use both of them to get over walls.
champion.builds: THE BEST GRAVES BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Graves Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Dark Harvest as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Legend: Alacrity and Triumph in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Youmuu's Ghostblade as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and The Collector. For your last 3 items, you should build Lord Dominik's Regards, Immortal Shieldbow and finish with Infinity Edge. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 51.6% winrate over 25 545 matches played. Optional Your second option for Graves Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Youmuu's Ghostblade, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and The Collector as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Lord Dominik's Regards, Immortal Shieldbow and Infinity Edge. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 51.5% win rate over 14 464 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Sundered Sky as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Black Cleaver as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 53.5% win rate across 2 330 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Graves Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Dark Harvest, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Legend: Alacrity with Triumph as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Hubris as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and The Collector as third item. The last 3 options are Lord Dominik's Regards, Infinity Edge and Immortal Shieldbow. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 53.8% win rate over 1 750 matches played. Situational Graves Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Graves build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Graves runes page.
